guard/30126.htm.text: Guard Rath: Rumor has it that the Great Wizard Hardin lives somewhere within the northern mountain range. Many young people have gone in search of that place to learn magic from him, but no one has actually met him yet. Those who say they have met him are liars.

links.text: Ask about the Great Wizard Hardin.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30126-1.htm.text: Guard Rath: There are all sorts of rumors about the great Wizard Hardin, but hardly anyone knows his true identity. Some say the demon Beleth is actually Hardin, others say that Hardin is the one who cursed the Dark Elves, and yet others say he helped King Rauhel unify the kingdom of Aden. I don't …

Q00300_HuntingLetoLizardman/30126-04.htm.text: Guard Rath: Please try harder! You must get rid of those filthy lizardmen who threaten trade between Aden and Oren.

Q00300_HuntingLetoLizardman/30126-05.htm.text: Guard Rath: You're finished? Good work, but we're not done with those vile creatures yet! I'm sure the plains will be swarming with lizardmen again in a few short weeks. Now, let me count those bracelets.

Q00300_HuntingLetoLizardman/30126-03.htm.text: Guard Rath: Destroy the lizardmen and take their bracelets as proof of your victory. Kill the Leto Lizardmen, Leto Lizardman Archers, Leto Lizardman Soldiers, Leto Lizardman Overlords', Leto Lizardman Warriors and so on. Don't attack their shaman! It might cause them to stop the ritual before our i…

Q00300_HuntingLetoLizardman/30126-06.htm.text: Guard Rath: Feel free to come back and help us anytime! The life of a mercenary may not pay well, but it has its rewards! Please accept this token of our appreciation.

Q00300_HuntingLetoLizardman/30126-07.htm.text: Guard Rath: I don't think so! You haven't brought enough! Bring 60 if you want a reward!
